title: Homecoming and Playlist
author: Emrys Sterling
blurb: Elodie Hartwell, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
